title: Research reaches code: every adopted finding names the existing implementation it reuses
body:
Source: operator 2026-11-16: papers and Fable 5.2 research must become code fast; reuse what already exists instead of writing from scratch; accuracy over cost.
Outcome: each research candidate (S30 file contract) carries `reuse:` (an existing OSS tool, library or skill to adopt, with URL) or `build-because:`; a candidate older than 7 days without a merged PR or a retire verdict is listed by `krn standards query --stale-research`; the next Fable plan is ranked by expected first-push-green and hidden-test gain, not cost.
Proof: a test rejects a candidate file without reuse or build-because; the stale listing prints 0 rows after the backlog is triaged.
Files: docs/program/fable-plan-brief.md, src/brain/proposals.ts
